environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. The Flask app runs directly via gunicorn with no reverse proxy filtering. The ELB performs TLS termination but does not inspect or modify HTTP request content. No AWS WAF is associated with the load balancer.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener port 443 -> instance port 8080
